definition: The standard leaderboard for embedding models across retrieval, clustering, classification, and STS tasks, with multilingual tracks.
details: The standard leaderboard for embedding models across retrieval, clustering, classification, and STS tasks, with multilingual tracks. Useful for shortlisting; final choice should be validated on your own domain and language.

explainer.lead: MTEB is the standard leaderboard for embedding models, covering retrieval, clustering, classification, and semantic textual similarity, with multilingual tracks. It matters as the common reference point for comparing embeddings.

tiers.eli5: It is a giant report card that scores text-embedding models on many different tests, so you can see which ones do well before picking one.
tiers.practitioner: Engineers use it to shortlist embedding models across task types and languages; the pitfall is treating leaderboard rank as decisive, since final choice should be validated on your own domain and language.
tiers.paperLevel: MTEB is the standard leaderboard for embedding models across retrieval, clustering, classification, and STS tasks, with multilingual tracks; it is useful for shortlisting but does not guarantee performance on a specific domain or language.

explainer.example: A team needing an embedding model for multilingual document search checks MTEB's multilingual tracks to shortlist candidates, then tests the shortlist on their own corpus.
